case1.title: Automating Efficiency in Ornamental Horticulture
case1.excerpt: LVG Plants partnered with Oboya Horticulture South Africa to automate pot plant wrapping.
case1.challenge: Manual wrapping was labor-intensive and limited daily dispatch capacity.
case1.solution: Four automatic pot plant wrapping machines, with phased installation through 2026.
case1.result: Expected higher capacity, consistency, and lower packing costs.

case2.title: Improving Post-Harvest Efficiency Through Integrated Logistics
case2.excerpt: Elite Flowers Colombia optimized internal logistics with trolleys, buckets, and tractors.
case2.challenge: Excessive manual movement of stems and materials slowed post-harvest operations.
case2.solution: Oboya Horticulture trolleys and buckets from 2020, with tractors added in 2025.
case2.result: Faster transportation, less fatigue, and smoother workflow performance.

case3.title: Advancing Traceability with RFID and AGV Automation
case3.excerpt: Elite Flowers Colombia pilots RFID tracking and AGV pallet systems with Oboya.
case3.challenge: Manual registration and pallet handling limited traceability and efficiency.
case3.solution: Pilot program evaluating RFID Tracking Systems and AGV Pallet Systems.
case3.result: Faster identification, improved traceability, and data for future deployment.

case4.title: Improving Productivity Through Inclusive Automation
case4.excerpt: Flor de Azama Farm achieved a 70% productivity gain with bouquet-tying automation.
case4.challenge: Manual sachet attachment caused discomfort and limited post-harvest output.
case4.solution: Automatic bouquet-tying machine with technical support and follow-up.
case4.result: 70% higher productivity with improved ergonomics and workplace inclusion.
